content.text: The northeast region of India also referred to as the country's seven sisters are considered among the most gorgeous, endearing, and wondrous places across the globe. In addition to being the only floating national park in the world, Northeast India is also known for having the cleanest hamlet in Asia and the wettest spot on the planet. This tour visit will take you around some of the most mesmerizing and fascinating places around Assam as you will get to visit the Kaziranga National Park and witness the beauty of the State of Assam.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Witness the lush tea plantations of Assam
Get a glimpse of the lifestyle of the people in Dibrugarh
Visit the oldest oil field in Digboi and get to know more about the oil fields and their functionality
Wildlife adventure trail around Kaziranga
Enjoy the beautiful parks of Kaziranga as you get a ride on the elephant back
Behold the breathtaking views of the region-specific flora and fauna
Explore Guwahati as you witness the cruise boat

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Dibrugarh
items: You will be picked up from the airport/ railway station and dropped off at the bungalow in the tea estates in Dibrugarh.
Once you freshen up, get to take a look at the tea factory.
Spend a pleasant evening at the tea plantations.

days.title: Day 2 : Dibrugarh Excursion
items: You can set off for a morning walk in the tea plantations to get a peaceful experience and cool your mind.
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and head out to meet the manager of the plantation to know, ask and see anything related to the plantations.
Towards the evening you can visit the tea worker's basti and get to know their style of living. You might also get a glimpse of their Jhumri Dance.

days.title: Day 3 : Dibrugarh-Digboi
items: After breakfast, check out of the Hotel in Dibrugarh and head to Digboi- the oil city of Assam.
Check in at the hotel and spend a peaceful evening.

days.title: Day 4 : Digboi Tour
items: After breakfast at the hotel, visit the oil fields, which are one of the oldest oil mills to be still functioning across the globe.
Digboi is not only an oil field but also has a museum featuring the oldest still-in-service oil equipment in the world.
To have a particularly enjoyable evening, drive along the winding roads in the twilight while passing the hillocks.
Later in the evening check in at your hotel for a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 5 : Digboi-Jorhat
items: Start early in the morning to the tea capital of Assam-Jorhat.
You will be accommodated at an Assamese village's Thengal Mansion, the famous ancestral home of a tea planter.
Take a stroll in a nearby village after lunch and some downtime to observe how basic their lifestyles are.
Check in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 6 : Jorhat- Kaziranga
items: After breakfast, visit the Toklai Research Station to know all about tea- plantations.
Later in the day, start off for the next destination Kaziranga.
Spend a leisurely evening at the hotel in wKaziranga after you’ve checked in.

days.title: Day 7 : Kaziranga Elephant Safari
items: Explore the beautiful park on an elephant ride early in the morning.
Also, get to see the unique and famous one-horned rhino in its native land.
Enjoy a leisure day at the central range of the park and have a peaceful evening at the hotel.

days.title: Day 8 : Kaziranga Excursion
items: After breakfast, go and take a look at the local villages and markets nearby.
You can also visit the tea estates of Kaziranga.
Have your lunch, visit the eastern range of the park and get a glimpse of the various flora and fauna.
Thereafter check in at your hotel for a good night sleep.

days.title: Day 9 : Kaziranga-Guwahati
items: After breakfast, at the hotel, check out and drive to Guwahati our final destination.
Visit the various famous places in Guwahati including the Basista Ashram and the evening Boat Cruise as well.
Check in at the hotel and spend a wonderful evening at Guwahati.

days.title: Day 10 : Guwahati Departure
items: After breakfast, drive down to the Guwahati Railway Station/ Airport and take back amazing memories of this splendid trip.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
